name: Select
description: The `p-select` component is a versatile custom form element that enables the selection of a single options. It can be used within a form or in a controlled manner.
code:
<input type=
checkbox
 id=
required
 name=
required
 checked=
checked
 />
<label for=
required
>Required</label>
<input type=
checkbox
 id=
deselection
 name=
deselection
 />
<label for=
deselection
>Allow deselection</label>
<form>
<p-select name=
options
 label=
Some Label
 required>
<p-select-option value=
1
>Option 1</p-select-option>
<p-select-option value=
2
>Option 2</p-select-option>
<p-select-option value=
3
>Option 3</p-select-option>
</p-select>
<button type=
submit
>Submit</button>
</form>
<p-text>Last submitted data: none</p-text>
<script>
const select = document.querySelector('p-select');
const required = document.querySelector('#required');
const deselection = document.querySelector('#deselection');
required.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
select.toggleAttribute('required', e.target.checked);
});
  deselection.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    if (e.target.checked) {
      select.prepend(document.createElement('p-select-option'));
    } else {
      document.querySelector('p-select-option:not([value])').remove();
    }
  });
  const debugElement = document.querySelector('p-text');
  const form = document.querySelector('form');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    debugElement.innerText = `Last submitted data: ${formData.get('options')}`;
  });
</script>

update.description: Emitted when the selection is changed.

dropdownDirection.description: Changes the direction to which the dropdown list appears.

form.description: The id of a form element the select should be associated with.

hideLabel.description: Show or hide label. For better accessibility it is recommended to show the label.

message.description: The message styled depending on validation state.

required.description: A Boolean attribute indicating that an option with a non-empty string value must be selected.

theme.description: Adapts the select color depending on the theme.

description.description: Shows a description. Only [phrasing content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Guide/HTML/Content_categories#Phrasing_content) is allowed.

label.description: Shows a label. Only [phrasing content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Guide/HTML/Content_categories#Phrasing_content) is allowed.

message.description: Shows a state message. Only [phrasing content](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Guide/HTML/Content_categories#Phrasing_content) is allowed.
